dog.description_text:
Meet Negroni!

Negroni is a beautiful girl with a wonderfully happy personality! This sweet girl loves meeting new people and is always excited to make a new person. She especially enjoys getting pets and soaking up all the attention she can get.

Negroni is also a big fan of treats, making her even more fun to get to know! With her cheerful spirit and affectionate nature, she’s sure to bring lots of smiles to her future family.

If you’re looking for a sweet, happy companion who loves people, pets, and tasty treats, Negroni may be a match for you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
